decisive_items: Peripheral blood smear showed occasional schistocytes
a repeat CT showed a new infarct in the left frontal lobe (left MCA territory)
response.rationale: TTP best fits microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, severe thrombocytopenia, and recurrent cerebral infarcts with normal coagulation studies; HUS is less likely without renal involvement, and DIC is excluded by normal coagulation and elevated fibrinogen.

rejected.why: No renal involvement and prominent neurologic/cerebral infarcts favor TTP over HUS.
Normal coagulation studies and elevated fibrinogen argue against DIC.
